title: Phase-indexed body states
statement: Given finite Turing machines $M_V$ and $M_I$ over the Boolean alphabet, associate a state type to each body-machine phase: the test phase uses a test-machine phase paired with a state for that phase, the clear phase uses the three sweep phases, and the increment phase uses a run phase, a Boolean-indexed rewind phase, or a Boolean-indexed done phase.
hypotheses_covered: two finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
